# web-ui-signals fixture

A small React web application. Every signal family that can fire from a repository this size
fires here, and none of them was written to game the classifier: this is what the evidence of a
web UI ordinarily looks like.

There is deliberately NO `project-policy.yml`. That makes this fixture the case that matters most
for the separation of classification from agreement: strong positive evidence with no declaration
must classify APPLICABLE with `agreement: undeclared`, never INDETERMINATE. A missing declaration
is a governance gap; it does not un-witness a user interface.
